coordinateSystem: Full source canvas; x right, y down; normalized by width and height; contact lies on lower pixel edge.
sourceSelection: Exact shipProfileAssetPath for every identity allowed by shipSupportsSurfaceInsertion; roles mothership/carrier/fleet/escape-pod excluded. Final gameplay excludes the individual AVP pod and its project-original variant as well; their already-inspected art remains documented.
limitations: These are source-art support contacts. A lower fin, rib or ornament can be the contact; no canonical landing gear is inferred.
groundExit retains the authored underside release socket. It does not establish a canonical door, ramp, or human-scale internal geometry.
Royal and shell thin antialiased extremities below the significant support are excluded by alpha >= 192 and the minimum three-pixel contiguous run.
Some catalogue-allowed hulls are depicted obliquely or as horizontal drop pods; no source rotation or redraw is introduced here.

physicalExitCorrection.reason: Ground exit bounded to significant silhouette support; original release anchor retained in the evidence below.
